plugins.name: session-relay
plugins.description: Cross-session, cross-project, cross-tool agent message bus (Claude Code + Codex). A SessionStart hook auto-registers sessions and drains inboxes; the MCP bus exposes whoami/register/roster/send/request/reply/inbox/discover; correlated MessageV2 requests admit one terminal reply; typed fan-out results are available through opt-in result JSON; and the CLI wakes idle targets with a tool-aware doorbell.
